correctness.rationale: Exact stationary elimination fixes the middle voltage to gamma and gives two independent scalar equations with at most three positive roots apiece. The general characteristic identity has been expanded algebraically from the actual six-dimensional derivative. Its value at lambda=1 equals mu times the two scalar derivative factors; one or two decreasing-branch roots always force a real eigenvalue above one. Consequently at most two ascending-branch roots per outer neuron can yield sinks. At the sharp rational witness, six rational intervals bracket three roots, full Jacobian block eigenvalues are enclosed, and a uniform Rouché margin (0.0005184 versus 0.00011239816) certifies precisely four hyperbolic sinks and five unstable equilibria. The standalone exact-rational checker executed successfully; no finite trajectory is treated as a proof of global stability.

value.rationale: This is a natural complete fixed-point upper-bound and sharp attainable local-stability census for the exact heterogeneous chain under broad positive parameters. A full six-dimensional spectral obstruction prevents stabilizing a middle scalar branch even when return coupling is arbitrarily strong, while an explicit strictly positive fully connected example has four open local attracting basins. The count resolves a substantive modeling question beyond numerical continuation, without asserting global neural or medical behavior.
